name: sifli
title: SiFli SF32LBxx
description: SiFli SF32LBxx series of ultra-low-power, high-performance ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers. This is a community PlatformIO platform that wraps the official SiFli SDK (RT-Thread based, built with SCons).

sifli-sdk.title: SiFli SDK
sifli-sdk.description: The official SiFli SDK build system (RT-Thread + SCons). The application directory must be a valid SiFli application (containing SConstruct, rtconfig.py, SConscript and src/). By default the SDK is auto-installed by PlatformIO into the `framework-sifli-sdk` package; you can override it with `sifli_sdk_dir` (platformio.ini) or the SIFLI_SDK environment variable.
